permits.why_needed: Establishes in-principle acceptance of tower height, massing, and use mix with the local authority / municipal planning authority before detailed design investment.
permits.evidence_required: Outline consent decision notice with reserved matters list

permits.why_needed: Grants legal permission to construct the tower as designed; all pre-commencement conditions must be discharged before site start.
permits.evidence_required: Decision notice granting permission plus condition discharge approvals

permits.why_needed: Demonstrates compliance of structure, fire safety, drainage, accessibility, and energy design with national building codes; required before and during construction stages.
permits.evidence_required: Full plans approval notice; staged inspection sign-offs during construction

permits.why_needed: Determines whether the tower requires a full environmental statement and frames assessment topics (wind, daylight, noise, ecology) for the planning submission.
permits.evidence_required: Screening opinion letter; scoping report and consultee responses if EIA required

permits.why_needed: Regulatory endorsement of the land remediation strategy ensuring safe redevelopment of contaminated ground and compliant disposal of soils.
permits.evidence_required: Regulator approval letter; remediation verification report at completion

permits.why_needed: Some authorities require specific consent for deep excavation adjacent to highways and neighbouring structures, reviewing excavation support and monitoring regimes.
permits.evidence_required: Permit letter with monitoring conditions attached

permits.why_needed: Statutory agreement with neighbouring owners whose buildings adjoin or are affected by excavation, piling, and crane tie-ins; required before works at the boundary.
permits.evidence_required: Executed party-wall awards for all affected boundaries

permits.why_needed: Authorises site enclosure and temporary closure of footpaths/lanes for crane erection, deliveries, and hoarding on the constrained urban street network.
permits.evidence_required: Permit with approved TM plan displayed on site

permits.permit_name: Crane Oversail / Lifting Operation Notification to Authority
permits.why_needed: Licences crane jibs slewing over public highway and notifies the authority of major lifting operations; includes indemnity insurance over third parties.
Permits opening or occupying the public highway for utility connections, vehicle crossovers, and reinstatement works.
permits.evidence_required: Street works licence with reinstatement categories

permits.why_needed: Authorises scaffolding and fan decks erected over or adjacent to the public footway protecting pedestrians from falling objects.
permits.evidence_required: Scaffold licence with weekly inspection tags maintained

permits.why_needed: Consent to abstract groundwater for basement dewatering and discharge treated water to sewer or watercourse within quality limits.

permits.permit_name: Utilities Connection Approvals (Electricity, Water, Gas, Telecom)
permits.why_needed: Formal connection agreements and capacity confirmations from utility providers for the tower's permanent supplies; long-lead items for energisation.
permits.evidence_required: Signed connection agreements with dated energisation commitments

permits.why_needed: Approval of the detailed fire strategy — evacuation, smoke control, firefighting provisions, facade fire performance — by the authority having jurisdiction.
Independent certification that temporary works (excavation support, crane ties, facade mast clamps) are adequately designed and checked before loading.
permits.evidence_required: Signed design check certificates per TW element

permits.permit_name: Heritage / Conservation Consent or Neighbour Approvals
permits.why_needed: Consent where the tower affects protected views, conservation areas, or listed settings; may include negotiated agreements with neighbouring institutions.
permits.evidence_required: Consent letters or recorded no-objection determinations
